jobs.title: Associate Director, Digital Product Management, Catalysts
jobs.description:
Join Amgens Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like youre part of something bigger, its because you are. Our shared missionto serve patients living with serious illnessesdrives all that we do.

Since 1980, weve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the worlds toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, youll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, youll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Associate Director, Digital Product Management, Catalyst

What You Will Do

Lets do this. Lets change the world. In this vital role you will embed complex, high-priority products and related product teams to accelerate Amgens adoption of the Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM), strengthen the product management capability, and help teams shift from output to outcome mindsets. Reporting to the Director, Product Management Catalysts, this individual contributor role will serve as a senior hands-on player-coach, partnering directly with Digital Product Managers, business leads, technology leads, data scientists, compliance and quality partners, adjacent product teams, product group leaders, and senior functional stakeholders.

This role will primarily embed with complex, interdependent individual products, though may operate across multiple related product teams when dependencies, stakeholder complexity, or where product outcomes require it. The Associate Director will coach and upskill DPMs and cross-functional teams while helping them apply DPOM practices to real product work. When no DPM is assigned, this role may temporarily perform product management responsibilities directly, including shaping product direction, aligning senior stakeholders, defining outcomes, resolving trade-offs, and supporting roadmap and prioritization decisions.

The Associate Director, Digital Product Management, Catalysts will help teams clarify high-priority business and user problems, shape product strategy, define measurable outcomes, improve roadmaps, establish OKRs and KPIs, support discovery, improve prioritization, manage cross-product dependencies, and connect delivery work to measurable value. This role will also capture learnings from embedded engagements and contribute insights back to the Product Management Hub to improve DPOM playbooks, tools, standards, Catalyst practices, and enterprise adoption approaches.

Responsibilities

Embedded Product Leadership and Coaching

Embed with complex, high-priority products and related product teams to improve product management practices and accelerate DPOM adoption.

Serve as a senior hands-on player-coach to Digital Product Managers and cross-functional team members.

Coach DPMs on advanced product management skills, including complex problem framing, continuous discovery, product strategy, outcome-based roadmaps, OKRs, KPIs, investment trade-offs, stakeholder alignment, and value measurement.

When no DPM is assigned, temporarily perform product management responsibilities directly, including shaping product direction, aligning stakeholders, defining outcomes, and supporting roadmap, capacity, and prioritization decisions.

Coach teams to combine user insights, product data, business context, and experimentation to make evidence-based product decisions.

Help teams move from stakeholder-request and feature-based delivery toward empowered, outcome-driven product management.

DPOM Adoption and Cross-Functional Team Enablement

Help cross-functional teams understand and apply DPOM practices in complex product environments.

Partner with business leads, technology leads, business analysts, design, data, compliance, quality, and adjacent product teams to strengthen product ways of working.

Help teams clarify roles, decision rights, operating rhythms, success measures, dependencies, and expectations within the Digital Product Operating Model.

Identify product management capability gaps, adoption barriers, and recurring anti-patterns across complex product environments.

Support teams in building durable product habits that continue after the Catalyst engagement ends.

Product Strategy, Outcomes, and Prioritization

Connect enterprise and business unit strategy to product strategy, helping teams break silos and translate strategic objectives into product outcomes and investment decisions.

Help teams frame complex, high-priority user and business problems and connect product work to measurable outcomes.

Support development of product vision, strategy, roadmaps, OKRs, KPIs, investment recommendations, and value realization plans.

Guide teams in making trade-off recommendations based on user needs, business value, feasibility, risk, capacity, dependencies, and enterprise priorities.

Support discovery, validation, and learning practices that help teams make better product decisions in ambiguous environments.

Help teams improve roadmap quality by shifting from feature and output lists to problem, opportunity, and outcome-oriented roadmaps that reflect product strategy, capacity, dependencies, and measurable value.

Cross-Product Dependencies and Stakeholder Influence

Identify and help resolve cross-product dependencies, sequencing challenges, and prioritization conflicts that affect product outcomes.

Influence business leads, technology leads, product group leaders, senior functional stakeholders, compliance partners, and adjacent product teams without formal authority.

Communicate clearly with team-level and senior stakeholders on product direction, adoption progress, trade-offs, risks, and decisions needed.

Help teams align near-term delivery decisions with longer-term product strategy and measurable outcomes.

Escalate major blockers, trade-offs, or alignment issues to the Director, Product Management Catalysts when needed.

Catalyst Model Execution and Continuous Improvement

Execute the Catalyst engagement model, including product/team assessment, engagement planning, embedded coaching, adoption measurement, transition planning, and learning capture.

Contribute to refinement of the Catalyst model based on practical learnings from complex embedded engagements.

Define and track success measures for each engagement, including DPM capability growth, cross-functional team adoption, product maturity, product outcomes when directly accountable, and sustained DPOM adoption outcomes following Catalyst transition.

Surface insights, risks, and recommendations to the Director, Product Management Catalysts and Product Management Hub leadership.

Translate lessons from embedded work into reusable examples, practices, templates, and playbook improvements.

What We Expect Of You

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Associate Director, Digital Product Management we seek is a senior product practitioner and coach with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications

Doctorate degree and 3 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience OR
Masters degree and 5 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience OR
Bachelors degree and 7 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience OR
Associates degree and 12 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience OR
High school diploma / GED and 14 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience

Preferred Qualifications

7+ years of progressive experience in digital product management, including product strategy, discovery, road mapping, prioritization, delivery, and outcome measurement.
Experience owning or leading complex, interdependent, high-priority products or product initiatives.
Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, or upskill product managers, product owners, business partners, and cross-functional team members.
Strong product management craft, including user and customer problem definition, product discovery, roadmap development, OKRs, KPIs, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, investment trade-off recommendations, and value realization.
Experience influencing senior business, technology, product, engineering, data, compliance, and adjacent product stakeholders without formal authority.
Ability to operate as a senior hands-on player-coach, balancing direct product leadership with coaching and capability building.
Proven ability to help teams shift from output-oriented delivery to outcome-oriented product management.
Strong judgment in ambiguous environments, including the ability to frame complex problems, resolve dependencies, make trade-off recommendations, and create practical paths forward.
Experience contributing to product operating models, playbooks, standards, templates, training, or adoption approaches preferred.
Experience in healthcare, biotechnology, or other regulated industries preferred; candidates from high-tech, digital, consulting, or product-led organizations are also encouraged to apply.
Familiarity with AI-native product development, generative AI workflows, responsible AI principles, and the evolving role of AI in product management preferred.

What You Can Expect Of Us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, well support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In Addition To The Base Salary, Amgen Offers a Total Rewards Plan, Based On Eligibility, Comprising Of Health And Welfare Plans For Staff And Eligible Dependents, Financial Plans With Opportunities To Save Towards Retirement Or Other Goals, Work/life Balance, And Career Development Opportunities That May Include

A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
Stock-based long-term incentives
Award-winning time-off plans
Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team. careers.amgen.com

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

Application deadline

Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position.

Sponsorship

Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed.

As an organization dedicated to improving

jobs.title: Director, Product Marketing
jobs.description:
About PAX

PAX is a leading global cannabis brand redefining how people experience the plant through thoughtful design, innovative technology, and a commitment to quality. For nearly two decades, PAX has crafted products that make cannabis simpler, more enjoyable, and more accessible, earning the trust of millions of consumers around the world.

Recognized by The New York Times’ Wirecutter, TIME, Fast Company, GQ, Gear Patrol, and more, PAX has built a brand at the intersection of cannabis, design, technology, and culture. We’re driven by the belief that cannabis can make life better, and that innovation can unlock its benefits in ways that set a higher standard for the category. Beyond our products, PAX is committed to moving the industry forward through advocacy, responsible access, social impact, and sustainability.

The Opportunity

PAX is seeking a Director of Product Marketing to lead product and portfolio marketing across our global device business and U.S. cannabis consumables business. This person will help determine where PAX plays, whom we serve, and how our products win. They will translate consumer insight, market dynamics, and business priorities into clear portfolio strategies, differentiated product positioning, and commercially rigorous go-to-market plans.

The Director will be involved throughout the product lifecycle, from opportunity identification and product definition through commercialization, launch, and ongoing optimization. They will serve as a critical connector among Product, Marketing, Creative, Sales, E-commerce, Operations, Finance, and Insights, ensuring every product has a clear consumer proposition, role within the portfolio, and plan for commercial success. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker and strong operator who can move easily between shaping a product roadmap, refining a positioning statement, developing a global launch plan, and evaluating in-market performance.

Role And Responsibilities

Shape the Portfolio

Lead product marketing across PAX’s device and consumables portfolios.
Define each product’s audience, consumer need, value proposition, and role within the broader portfolio.
Turn consumer insights, category trends, and business data into product roadmap recommendations and compelling business cases.
Help shape portfolio architecture, pricing, and lifecycle strategies across formats, markets, channels, and price points.
Translate technical information into simple, differentiated benefits that matter.

Bring Products to Market

Own go-to-market strategy for new products, line extensions, relaunches, and other major portfolio initiatives.
Define the audience, positioning, channel strategy, commercial requirements, and success metrics for each launch.
Create clear, insight-led briefs that align Product, Creative, Brand, E-commerce, Sales, Trade Marketing, Communications, Operations, and Finance.
Adapt launch plans across PAX’s distinct channels, including e-commerce, domestic and international wholesale, and licensed dispensaries.
Keep teams focused and accountable, surfacing risks and driving decisions early enough to protect timing and quality.
Equip sales teams and channel partners with compelling product stories, training, and tools that drive sell-in and sell-through.

Drive the Business Forward

Own the ongoing commercial health of products beyond launch, developing lifecycle strategies that sustain relevance, velocity, and profitability over time.
Build a deep understanding of how consumers discover, evaluate, purchase, and repurchase PAX products across channels.
Track product and launch performance across revenue, distribution, velocity, conversion, consumer response, and profitability.
Identify and lead lifecycle opportunities including pricing and promotion, bundles, product refreshes, new channel or market expansion, repositioning, and end-of-life planning.
Partner with Brand, E-commerce, Sales, and Trade Marketing to evolve messaging, content, merchandising, and demand-driving programs based on product performance and consumer behavior.
Turn performance data, competitive intelligence, and partner feedback into clear recommendations for how to accelerate, optimize, or rationalize the portfolio.
Lead post-launch and ongoing business reviews, translating insights into specific actions, owners, and success metrics.
Build repeatable processes that bring greater clarity, rigor, and accountability to how PAX launches, grows, and manages products throughout their lifecycle.

How You’ll Work

Bring structure and clarity to complex, fast-moving work.
Build trust across teams and lead effectively through influence.
Balance strong strategic thinking with a willingness to get into the details.
Communicate clearly, make thoughtful recommendations, and push decisions forward.
Stay curious about consumers, the category, and what the data is telling us.
Operate with high ownership, sound judgment, and low ego.

Qualifications

8-12+ years of experience in product marketing, portfolio strategy, or commercialization.
Demonstrated success leading complex product launches across multiple channels, markets, or business models.
Strong experience in consumer insight, segmentation, positioning, messaging and consumer-facing product copy, pricing, and go-to-market strategy.
A proven ability to translate consumer needs and technical product details into differentiated, commercially effective stories.
Experience partnering closely with Product, Sales, Creative, Operations, and Finance teams.
Strong commercial and analytical judgment, including the ability to evaluate market opportunities and product performance.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to influence leaders and cross-functional teams.
Brings structure, clarity, and momentum to fast-paced work with evolving priorities.
Hands-on approach and willingness to operate at both strategic and executional levels.
Experience in consumer tech, CPG, wellness, cannabis, or another regulated category.
Experience with wholesale, retail, DTC, and/or dispensary channels.
Genuine enthusiasm about cannabis consumers and building the future of the category.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Compensation

In addition to the benefits below, this role has a pay range between $160,000 and $210,000 and equity. The pay range represents what we believe, in good faith, this role will pay. The final salary offer will be determined based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, depth of experience, geographic location, and relevant education or training.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.title: VP, Growth Director
jobs.description:
Job Description:

We are seeking a VP, Growth Director to serve as a strategic growth partner with deep expertise in data, technology, and platforms. This role sits within our Growth organization and bridges our Growth and Data, Technology & Tools (DT&T) teams to unlock capacity and strengthen our ability to win complex client pursuits.

You'll be a hands-on growth leader who partners with our Chief Growth Officer and executive leadership to develop compelling narratives around our data and technology capabilities, lead pitch strategy and development, and manage the end-to-end execution.

You’ll build strong partnerships, bring structure to complex pursuits, and create clear, persuasive stories that connect data and technology capabilities to measurable business value.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the end-to-end development of data and technology components for RFIs, RFPs, pitches, and client presentations.
Translate complex technical concepts into clear business narratives and value propositions for executive and technical audiences.
Partner with Growth, Data, Technology & Tools, product, sales, and client teams to shape tailored solutions and competitive positioning.
Lead pitch preparation and client engagements, including executive presentations and technical discussions.
Develop and refine high-impact pitch materials, playbooks, case studies, value propositions, and enablement resources.
Stay current on emerging technologies, market trends, and competitor offerings to identify opportunities for differentiation.
Use pitch outcomes and client feedback to continuously improve messaging, solution development, and pursuit execution.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, business, marketing, engineering, or a related field.
8+ years of progressive experience in growth, business development, or solution development within data, technology, platforms, marketing technology, or advertising technology.
Experience supporting complex client pursuits in an agency or consulting environment, including RFI and RFP development, pitch strategy, and client presentations.
Strong working knowledge of data platforms, identity solutions, analytics, AI and machine learning, marketing technology, first-party data strategies, data integration, and identity resolution.
Exceptional storytelling, presentation, and written communication skills, with the ability to make complex information accessible and compelling.
Strong project management skills and the ability to deliver high-quality work across multiple priorities and tight deadlines.
Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate across executive leadership, technical teams, product organizations, and client-facing teams.
Comfort operating in fast-paced, evolving, and ambiguous environments.

At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our hybrid way of working combines remote flexibility with regular in-person collaboration to spark ideas and

strengthen our teams. Many of our employees who live within commuting distance (90 minutes) from one of our Headquarter or Hub Offices (New York, Chicago, Detroit, Los Angeles) are required to work in the office 2-3 days per week including one Team Day. The minimum number of days may vary by office and role. Dentsu may designate other HQ or Hub offices at any time. Those who do not live near an office may be designated as a remote employee, depending on the role and business needs. Regardless of your work location, we expect you to be flexible to meet the needs of our Company and clients, which may include attendance in an office from time to time.

The annual base salary range for this position is $164,450-$180,000. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law. Additionally, this position is eligible for discretionary incentive compensation.

Benefits available with this position include:

Medical, vision, and dental insurance,
Life insurance,
Short-term and long-term disability insurance,
401k,
Flexible paid time off,
At least 15 paid holidays per year,
Paid sick and safe leave, and
Paid parental leave.

Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. For more information regarding dentsu benefits, please visit www.dentsubenefitsplus.com.

To begin the application process, please click on the “Apply” button at the top of this job posting. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and qualified candidates will be contacted for next steps.

New York

Dentsu Solutions
